regime.summary: Sunday 17:23 UTC in a post-liquidation R9 cell across BTC, ETH and SOL (xs.json regime.cell); CME reopens 23:00 UTC. All three have bounced back inside their 24h value areas after the flush, each pinned within ~0.5 x 1h ATR of its 24h POC with unswept swing lows and round numbers stacked close by on both sides.

ideas.thesis: BTC (64,784) sits almost exactly on its 24h POC (64,795, +0.0A) with the 65,000 round stacked +0.3A above - tight overhead confluence. Below, an unswept 15m swing low at 64,235 (-0.7A) rests just above the day open 64,122 (-0.8A); traders who bought that 16:15Z low still have stops resting under it, not yet released.

invalidation.condition: 1h close below the unswept 15m swing low 64,235 releases those resting stops and opens the day open 64,122 / 64,000 round

ideas.reasoning: Ranked 1: BTC anchors the regime and has the tightest, cleanest level stack on both sides (two kinds within 0.3A each way); the other majors repeat this pattern at wider spacing.

ideas.thesis: ETH (1,813.84) trades inside its 24h value area, 0.5A under the POC (1,828.72) and 1.0A under the VAH (1,841.10). The nearest stop pool is an unswept 15m low at 1,801.85 (-0.4A) stacked on the 1,800 round just beneath. The model's estimated long-liq cluster sits far lower at 1,664 (-8.6%), consistent with R-RB-2: the flush low is usually still ahead of the first local pool.

invalidation.condition: 1h close below 1,801.85 (unswept 15m low) stacked on the 1,800 round sweeps that pool, with no further live level until the 1h+15m low at 1,772.02 (-1.5A)

ideas.reasoning: Ranked 2: same stack pattern as BTC, but the nearby pool (one swing + one round) is thinner and the liq cluster underneath is a model estimate, not an observed level.

ideas.thesis: SOL (71.27) is pinned almost on its 24h POC (71.11, -0.1A) with the 71.00 round and two unswept 15m swing lows (70.94, 70.91) stacked within the same 0.3A band below - four level kinds in a tight box. Above, 72.00 round + 24h VAH 72.45 sit near +1.0A, then a confluence 15m+1h swing high at 73.23 (+1.7A).

invalidation.condition: 1h close below 70.91 (stacked with the 71.00 round and the 24h POC) sweeps that stop pool and opens air toward the 24h VAL

ideas.reasoning: Ranked 3: the downside stack is the tightest confluence of the three majors (four kinds inside 0.3A), but SOL's book is thinner than BTC/ETH (tape.md depth25 ~3.5M/3.7M), so the same distance moves on less size.

ideas.thesis: SOPH is flagged (rs24h -2.2sd, funding p5 ann -3393%, OI24h +26.4%, basis -54bp); tape.md's pattern reads OI rising into the drop, i.e. new shorts opened as price fell. Those shorts' stops sit at the overhead confluence of the 0.0013 round (+0.1A) and the 7d POC 0.001327 (+0.2A). A separate three-way confluence (7d VAL, week open, 15m low) sits -0.2A below.

invalidation.condition: 1h close above the 0.0013 round / 0.001327 7d-POC confluence stops out shorts opened into this drop

ideas.reasoning: Ranked 4: the flag plus the tape's new-shorts-into-the-drop pattern gives a specific trapped-party story the majors lack, but SOPH's book is thin (bid $329 / ask $91 at 10bp) and the 24h move is -57.7%, so this is informative structure, not a liquid setup.

ideas.thesis: INIT is flagged for OI24h +23.1% and basis +27bp, and pays extreme funding (ann +1205%, p95) - crowded longs rebuilding after a drop (tape.md). Price (0.1131) sits just above a thin cushion at the 7d POC 0.1114 (-0.2A) and the 0.11 round (-0.4A), below the reclaimed prior week low 0.1172 (+0.5A), now role-reversed resistance.

invalidation.condition: 1h close below the 7d POC 0.1114 and the 0.11 round opens air to the prior day high 0.1079 with nothing live between, flushing the rich-funding longs

ideas.reasoning: Ranked 5 (last): the funding/OI flag is extreme and the cushion below is thin, but INIT's 60m move already round-tripped (-2.4% per tape.md) on thin liquidity, so this stays watch-only structure, not a high-confidence setup.

data_gaps: tape.json flow is 'not collected' for SOPHUSDT and INITUSDT, so the OI/funding-driven trapped-party stories can't be cross-checked against taker flow this cycle.

SOPHUSDT book is thin (l1_usd bid $329 / ask $91): the cited confluence is a place where stops concentrate, not a level with size behind it.

honesty.base_rate: R-PX-4: an approached structural level breaks slightly more often than it holds (52-55%); a flat coin-flip is the right prior for any single touch cited here.
conflicts: R-AVOID-1 / R-MAP-6: pivot-geometry and swing-structure trend ideas have failed historically - every stack above is a place where stops concentrate, not a forecast of which way price goes.
R-RB-2: after a flush the 7-day low is usually still ahead of the first local pool (true for BTC/ETH/SOL here; ETH's modeled long-liq cluster sits -8.6%, well below the cited stop pool).
SOPHUSDT / INITUSDT theses lean on tape.json's players.pattern label (OI/funding behaviour), which is a pattern, not an observed position book.
honesty.what_would_change_my_mind: the next geometry snapshot showing any cited swing flip to swept=true, or a tape.json liq cluster firing (R-FLOW-2) at one of these prices.
